sources.title: CUDA C++ Programming Guide: L2 Policy for Persisting Accesses
sources.verified_claim: hitRatio selects an approximately random fraction of accesses for hitProp; persisting accesses have priority in a shared set-aside and unused capacity remains usable by normal/streaming accesses.

sources.title: Parallel Thread Execution ISA: createpolicy
sources.verified_claim: fractional cache policy applies primary eviction priority with the specified probability and secondary priority to the remainder; it is an eviction-priority hint, not a semantic-class quota.

sources.title: AutoScratch: ML-Optimized Cache Management for Inference-Oriented GPUs
sources.verified_claim: uses ML to select address slices for L2 residency/pinning in inference, with configurations kept static within an iteration; it optimizes selection rather than equal-share fairness among sequential semantic classes.

sources.title: Priority-Based Cache Allocation in Throughput Processors

sources.title: Orchestrating Cache Management and Memory Scheduling for GPGPU Applications
sources.verified_claim: assigns request/cache-line priorities, permits replacement by lower or equal priority, and bypasses when no eligible victim exists; priority and bypass are known dimensions.

sources.title: Locality-Driven Dynamic GPU Cache Bypassing
